content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

The architecture behind Solana payments for digital products is a robust framework designed to empower creators in regions underserved by traditional payment platforms. Rather than relying on intermediaries that charge high fees, this infrastructure allows you to collect payments directly in cryptocurrency, thereby minimizing costs and maximizing profits. For instance, while services like Gumroad charge 10% on each sale, NOWPayments only takes a mere 0.5%. This difference can significantly impact your bottom line, enabling you to retain more of your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture utilizes Solana's blockchain technology to facilitate fast, low-cost transactions. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the payment in real-time, converting cryptocurrency into USD at the time of the transaction. This means you can set your prices in dollars while accepting payments in various cryptocurrencies. Coupled with automated delivery systems like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, your digital products can be delivered immediately upon payment confirmation, ensuring a smooth experience for both you and your customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically tailored for digital creators operating in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, the ability to accept cryptocurrency directly opens up new markets and opportunities. By eliminating reliance on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, you gain sovereignty over your business operations. This infrastructure isn't just built for survival; it's built for growth, allowing you to scale your digital offerings without being hindered by platform fees.
Now you can keep 99.5% of your sales instead of losing money to high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of this architecture relies on several key components working in harmony. First, you have your hosting solution, which can be GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, offering free and reliable storage for your digital products. Then, there’s the backend logic handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates processes like order fulfillment. Finally, NOWPayments integrates the payment processing layer, allowing for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Together, these elements create a cohesive system that empowers you to sell digital products efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying this architecture, begin by selecting your hosting solution, whether GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you configure your payment settings properly. Once everything is in place, test the entire flow from purchase to product delivery to confirm it works as expected. This streamlined approach will enable you to launch your digital store in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments directly in digital currencies. With the right setup, such as utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can create a seamless buying experience for your customers, bypassing traditional barriers and fees.
Automated delivery ensures your customers receive their purchases instantly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital products without relying on conventional platforms, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the tools you need. It includes all six blueprints and seven templates essential for building and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook without using PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments, which accept various digital currencies. This allows you to bypass traditional platforms and keep more of your profits.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on each transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This fee structure allows you to retain more of your earnings.
Can I use this architecture for digital courses as well?
Absolutely. This architecture is ideal for selling various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and more, all while keeping your payment processing costs low.
How quickly can I set this up?
You can deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack within 48 hours, depending on your familiarity with the tools involved. With the right setup, you can start selling almost immediately.
What kind of support is available during deployment?
When you purchase a Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30 days of support to help you through the deployment process and answer any questions.
